core.title: 83-inch Bommer Wide Throw Full Mortise Continuous Geared Hinge WTFM83HD

text.description_html:
83" Bommer Wide Throw Full Mortise Continuous Geared Hinge WTFM83HD.

Heavy Duty
Length: 83"
Metal: Aluminum
Number of bearings: 27
Heavy Door Weight: 540 lbs.

Unlike a conventional hinge, a Continuous Geared Aluminum hinge has no pin. Also, it is not like a "piano" hinge either, which has 50% of each knuckle cut away, and depends on a thin wire to hold each leaf together.

A Continuous Geared Aluminum hinge consists of two full-height, paired and geared leafs. Each geared leaf rotates evenly from top to bottom, riding on superior Delrin Teflon bearings. The geared leafs and bearings are held together by a full length channel cap. This assembly retains the smooth, clean lines of the door and frame, while easily supporting heavy vertical loads.

Advantages to Bommer Continuous Geared Hinges:

1. Distributes load stress uniformly along the full length of the door
2. Diffuses wear and tear from closer kickback shock and elminates door sagging and binding
3. Attaching screws are along the full length, preventing warpage
4. Gear design offers little effort to open a large heavy commercial door
5. High degree of security against prying and force.
6. Offers a closed gap, providing safety against pinched fingers, especially suited for public locations where children are present.
7. UL Fire labeled 3-hour A-label.
